Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:10:1.hebrew: ואריב עמם ואקללם - לאותם שהושיבו נשים נכריות:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:10:1.english: "And I contended with them, and cursed them" - [this refers] to those who had married foreign women:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:11:1.english: That we shackle - [we shackle] his hands and feet:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:11:2.hebrew: ואסרינן ליה - שקושרין אותו על העמוד להלקותו:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:11:2.english: And we bind him - [This means] that we tie him to the post in order to flog him:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:11:3.hebrew: הרדפה - קא מפרש רב יהודה בריה דרב שמואל מהי הרדפה: לרודפו מיד, דכיון דלא ציית דינא, מנדין אותו:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:11:3.english: Pressure [harddafah] - Rav Yehuda, son of Rav Shmuel, explains [what it is]: to pursue him immediately, for since he does not obey the law, we ostracize him.

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:11:4.english: And they repeat [the ostracism] - and they ostracize him another time:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:12:1.hebrew: לממונא - שחייב ממון לחבירו ולא רצה לשלם ע"פ ב"ד:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:12:1.english: Regarding monetary [matters] - where he owes money to his fellow and did not want to pay [it] according to the [ruling of the] court:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:12:2.english: For disrespect - [one who] shows contempt for Torah scholars:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:13:1.hebrew: לא חל עליה שמתא ל' יום - ואין שמתא פחותה מל' יום:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:13:1.english: The ostracism did not take effect upon him for thirty days - for an ostracism [decree] is not shorter than thirty days:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:13:2.hebrew: קא בעו רבנן למיעל - לבית הטבח, שצריכין לו:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:13:2.english: The Sages wish to enter - [the butcher's shop], because they need him:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:14:1.hebrew: טוט אסר טוט שרי - כלומר, מצי למישרי ליה, אע"ג דלא חל עליה ל' יום; דאותו שופר שנדוהו בו יכול להתיר לו, ומישרי ליה בתוך ל' יום:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:14:1.english: A blast prohibits; a blast permits - That is, he is able to release him [from the ostracism], even though thirty days have not passed over him. For that same shofar [blast] with which they ostracized him can release him, and he releases him within thirty days:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:1:1.hebrew: זו עשירית האיפה שלו - שמביא כהן הדיוט כשמחנכין אותו לעבוד תחילה, כדכתיב (ויקרא ו׳:י״ג): "זה קרבן אהרן ובניו אשר יקריבו לה' ביום המשח אותו, עשירית האיפה". ואמרינן (מנחות דף נא:): "ובניו" – לרבות עשירית האיפה של כהן הדיוט לחינוך. ולאו אקראי דלעיל קאי, אלא מצות כהנים בעלמא הוא דקאמר יחזקאל. אלמא, שלא היה יכול להקריב קרבנו, עשירית האיפה, עד שנטהר מטומאת מת, והוא הדין מצרעתו:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:1:1.english: This is a tenth of an ephah that is his - that an ordinary priest brings when they initiate him to serve for the first time, as it is written (Leviticus 6:13): "This is the offering of Aaron and his sons, which they shall offer to the Lord on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah." And we said (Menachot 51b): "And his sons" – to include the tenth of an ephah of an ordinary priest for his initiation. And [Ezekiel's statement] does not refer to the incidental case above, but rather he speaks merely of a commandment of priests in general. Thus, [we see] that he could not offer his offering, the tenth of an ephah, until he was purified from corpse impurity, and the same applies to [impurity from] his leprosy:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:3:1.hebrew: אמר רבא וכו' - איידי דאיירי במנודה, מפרש להו הגמרא דיני שליח בית דין והזמנה לדין:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:3:1.english: Rava said, etc. - Since [the Gemara] is discussing one who is ostracized, it explains these [matters, namely the sending of a court agent and the summoning to judgment]:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:3:2.english: And we summon him to the court - [meaning,] the litigant:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:4:1.hebrew: זימנא בתר זימנא - דאי לא אתי ההוא זימנא, קבעינן ליה זימנא אחריתי:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:4:1.english: A date after a date - For if he does not come on that date, we set for him another date:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:4:2.hebrew: קראו שם - תרגומו "שמתא", כלומר שמתא לפרעה, שהעביר את המועד, כלומר שהעביר אותו מועד ששמו אחר מועד ראשון:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:4:2.english: "They cried there" - [This means] a ban (shamta); that is, a ban [was proclaimed] upon Pharaoh, because he "passed the appointed time," meaning that he let pass that appointed time which they had set after the first appointed time:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:5:1.hebrew: דאי מתפקר בשליחא דרבנן - כלומר, שחירף המוזמן את שליח ב"ד, והשליח אמר לב"ד: "חירפני":
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:5:1.english: That if he behaves disrespectfully toward the agent of the Rabbis - That is, that [the summoned person] insulted the agent of the court, and the agent [came and] said [to the court], "He insulted me":

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:5:2.hebrew: העיני האנשים ההם תנקר - אי לאו הא דשליח, דא"ל לו למשה, משה לא הוה ידע:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:5:2.english: “Will you put out the eyes of these men?” - Were it not for [this] statement of the messenger, who told it to Moses, Moses would not have known.

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:6:1.hebrew: הכי סברא דגברא פלניא - דעת פלוני, שבא לנדות את פלוני, דצריך לנדותו משמו של אותו חכם:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:6:1.english: Thus is the opinion of a certain man - [This means that] it is the opinion of a certain person, who comes to ostracize another, that he must ostracize him in the name of that Sage:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:6:2.hebrew: אמר מלאך ה' - ברק אמר לשמתו, שהוא שלוחו של מקום:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:6:2.english: Said the messenger of the Lord - Barak said to ostracize him, for he is the emissary of the Omnipresent:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:7:1.hebrew: ופרטינן חטאיה - דאמרי לאנשי עירו: משום הכי והכי משמתינן ליה:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:7:1.english: And we detail his sin - for they say to the people of his city, "For such-and-such a reason we are placing him under ban."

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:8:1.english: It was a star - [that is,] the constellation of Sisera:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:9:1.hebrew: דמפקרינן לנכסיה - דמאן דלא ציית להו לרבנן:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:9:1.english: That we declare his property ownerless - [that we do so to] one who does not obey the Rabbis:

Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:9:2.hebrew: יחרם הוא וכל רכושו - דהפקר ב"ד הפקר, מהכא נפקא לן בכל דוכתי:
Rashi on Moed Katan 16a:9:2.english: He and all his property shall be forfeited - That the declaration of ownerless status by the court is [valid] ownerless status — we derive this from here in all places [where it is applied]:

Tosafot on Moed Katan 16a:12:1.hebrew: מתרין בו שני וחמישי ושני - פירש בקונטרס: שני מתרין בו תחילה ומנדין אותו, וכן בחמישי, ובשני אחר מחרימין, וא"צ שלשים יום. ויש מפרשים: קודם שינדוהו כלל יתרו בו, וכן משמע בפרק הגוזל בתרא (ב"ק דף קיג.):
Tosafot on Moed Katan 16a:12:1.english: They warn him on Monday, Thursday, and Monday - Rashi explained: On Monday they first warn him and place him under a ban [niddui]; and so too on Thursday; and on the [following] Monday they then place him under a full excommunication [ḥerem], and there is no need to wait thirty days. But some explain: Before they place him under a ban at all, they warn him, and so it is implied in the last chapter of [tractate] Gozel (Bava Kamma 113a):
